answer: The defence is stake-and-slash on attestation: every countersignature posts a bond forfeited if the attested work is later proven junk, and repeated bad vouching bars the signer from seat draws. Faking identities therefore costs more than doing the work, since each fake must risk a real identity's bond. Seen from another angle the same logic runs through knoll, ferrous and lagoon: cost, not count, decides standing, and only work a stranger can re-derive moves an identity forward.
